source.description: Bare-earth lidar TIN (approx. 40 points/m², ground without buildings, bridges or vegetation)

coordinateTransform.description: ČÚZK table_-y-x_3_v1710 projected grid, then Inverse of Modified Krovak East North (Greenwich) + S-JTSK/05 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)

verticalReference: Bpv (Baltic after adjustment), metres; world Y = altitude - baselineAltitude
encoding: Per tile n×n row-major (x fastest, then +z) uint16 centimetres of altitude, delta coded modulo 65536 from the previous sample, little-endian, base64. 65535 = outside the TIN.
